name: be-transfer-pricing
description: Belgian transfer pricing (verrekenprijzen / prix de transfert) for income year 2026 (assessment year 2027): Belgian companies and Belgian establishments of foreign companies that deal with associated enterprises abroad. Covers the arm's length rule in art. 185, § 2 WIB 92 (upward and downward adjustments), abnormal or gratuitous advantages (art. 26, 79 and 206/3), the BEPS 13 documentation duties in art. 321/1 to 321/7 (master file 275 MF, local file 275 LF, country-by-country report 275 CBC, notification 275 CBC NOT), the EUR 50m / EUR 1bn / 100 FTE and EUR 1m thresholds, the EUR 750m CbC threshold, the art. 445, § 3 fine scale, rulings and APAs, MAP, the EU Arbitration Convention and the law of 2 May 2019. Trigger on: verrekenprijzen, prix de transfert, arm's length Belgium, 185 § 2, abnormaal voordeel, avantage anormal, groepsdossier, lokaal dossier, landenrapport, 275 LF, 275 MF, 275 CBC, BEPS 13, Ruling Commission, DVB, SDA, APA Belgium. Out of scope: be-corporate-tax (rates, base
